name: migrate-the-issues
problem: The retired issues/ folder's four open items, planned as one migration. Two are authoring-surface defects hardened behavior-only in the authoring-pressure round @ v0012 (verifications-forgive-the-dash: a Satisfy bullet must not void on the wrong dash; satisfaction-names-the-interface: satisfied-by and link SpecRefs must resolve ports and edges, not only whole nodes). Two are deferred product surfaces that entered as intents @ v0013 (reports-name-their-element: every finding and report line carries its element's id; priorities-weight-the-read: a trade-off configuration situates the scoring read). This plan projects v0013 and stops at authoring — no wave has started; the two new-node tasks (t3, t4) implement nodes already sealed in v0013, so execution adds code, never model.

technology_stack.tech: Rust 2024; crates/archi: docs/schema.rs (verification-bullet recognizer + tag-shaped-miss diagnostic), docs/mod.rs (satisfied-by cross-check), links/mod.rs (SpecRef parser); crates/modeling-lang: model.rs (the port/edge resolution the two reference layers share)
technology_stack.provenance: the defects live exactly where tool.arch places DocsCompiler (parse + schema + cross-check) and Links (SpecRef resolution); the shared resolver is the modeling-lang Model both consult, so one primitive keeps satisfied-by and link refs from disagreeing about what an element is

technology_stack.tech: new crates/archi/src/addressing.rs — stamps the element locus a finding/diagnostic already knows (located, coded) onto the human and json surface; main.rs renders the id and query/search resolve it back
technology_stack.provenance: reports-name-their-element: the ids exist internally (absolute paths, slugs, located diagnostics); the work is carrying them out, so Addressing is a thin projection over existing loci, not new identity

technology_stack.tech: new crates/archi/src/tradeoffs.rs — the configuration and the auto mode that polls the operator; crates/modeling-lang/src/nkp.rs and incidence.rs consult the weighting; main.rs adds the verb
technology_stack.provenance: priorities-weight-the-read: the scoring layer is the natural consumer; the weighting rides into the existing Nkp/Incidence reads, and an absent configuration leaves them byte-identical to today so the change is additive

architecture_summary.role: the doc-authoring surface: its verification-bullet recognizer forgives the separator and speaks up on a tag-shaped miss; its satisfied-by cross-check resolves port paths and canonical edge text against the model
the SpecRef parser accepts a port path exactly where it already accepts canonical edge text, so a link and a satisfaction name the same vocabulary
the projection that stamps every emitted finding, diagnostic and report line with the id of the element it concerns, in human and json, round-tripping through query/search
the operator's up-front priorities, set or auto-derived, handed to the scoring read as a weighting; absent, the read is exactly today's

stack_mapping.tech: crates/archi/src/docs/schema.rs — verification_bullet accepts -/–/—; a tag-shaped miss raises a located diagnostic
crates/archi/src/docs/mod.rs + crates/modeling-lang/src/model.rs — satisfied-by cross-check and the shared port/edge resolver
crates/archi/src/links/mod.rs — SpecRef parser extended to port paths
crates/archi/src/addressing.rs (new) + crates/archi/src/main.rs — id stamping and rendering
crates/archi/src/tradeoffs.rs (new) + crates/modeling-lang/src/nkp.rs + crates/archi/src/main.rs — configuration, auto mode, weighted read, the verb

scenarios: a Satisfy bullet whose separator is an ASCII hyphen (or en-/em-dash) counts its verification; a `- test:` line that opens the tag but misses the shape draws the located diagnostic naming the canonical `- test — …`, while a `*` bullet or a mistyped `- tests —` tag stays ordinary prose — never a silent zero, checked on a fixture and on this repository's own docs

`satisfied-by: [Engine.answer]` and a `satisfied-by` naming a conn edge both resolve and validate; `archi link add Engine.answer <file#symbol>` resolves the port instead of raising E_MODEL_REF — satisfaction and links accept one vocabulary

on this repository's own `archi check`, every finding and diagnostic line carries a resolvable element id in both the human and the --json surface; the id pasted into `archi query` or `archi search` lands on exactly the element the line fired on

with a trade-off configuration favouring simplicity over scalability, `archi nkp` weights the landscape read by it; the same model with no configuration reads byte-identically to today, and the auto mode derives a configuration from answered prompts
`archi check` stays green and `archi version current` reports v0013 unmoved after every task — the migration adds behavior and fills two sealed nodes with code, disturbing no canonical byte

tasks.description: verification-bullet recognizer forgives -/–/— and warns on tag-shaped misses; satisfied-by cross-check resolves port paths and canonical edge text
tasks.stack_details: docs/schema.rs: verification_bullet strips the tag then accepts any of -/–/— before the description; a line that opens with `test`/`type-level` but still fails the shape (wrong bullet char, tag typo, missing separator) raises a located E_DOC naming the canonical `- test — …` rather than falling through to prose. docs/mod.rs: the satisfied-by cross-check, today Model::has_node, calls a widened resolver that also matches a port path (Node.port) and canonical edge surface text against the pinned model. modeling-lang/src/model.rs: the shared resolver — resolve_element(path) returning node | port | edge — so satisfied-by (here) and the link SpecRef parser (t2) cannot disagree about what resolves. Inline unit tests for each dash form, the tag-shaped-miss diagnostic, and port/edge satisfied-by resolution.

a-dark-corpus-stays-partial: e2e: archi search degrades per-corpus on a broken tree — element cards darken with a dark note (model corpus + first diagnostic), unparseable docs fall to raw-text cards, and the verb exits zero while archi check still exits one
a-link-is-fact-plus-projection: unit: a link stays an immutable birth record — spans, content hash, resolved symbol, canonicalizer version — in the journal as its one store, while verify recomputes the derived projection and never writes it back
a-passing-check-ends-on-the-landscape: e2e: a passing archi check closes on the default-slice NKP read — the bare scoring line plus coupling directions; an empty landscape (N=0) earns none, --json carries the same read without the matrix, and advisory findings never withhold it
a-plan-projects-a-pinned-spec: unit: plan use/repin pins the live model's saved version and refuses a dirty or unversioned model, validates the envelope (problem, stack, summary, mapping), and re-derives task obligations against the pin so verify flags drift
a-stressor-presses-one-hypothesis: unit: DocsCompiler holds the stressor schema — a non-empty affects list (E_AFFECTS_EMPTY), outcome/resolution coupled (a bare verdict or bare argument is E_DOC), affects resolved per pinned version with types expanding to their terms
absence-is-not-drift: e2e: a link into an unmapped member grades Unreachable (upstream of Missing) — verify emits no decay, audit --prune leaves it untouched, and only verify --repo <member> turns that absence into a nonzero exit
an-intent-is-a-problem-statement: unit: DocsCompiler parses each folder-named file as its intent and walks the folder as its requirement tree, checking schema/slug/placement and rejecting any requirement that sits outside an intent folder
breaking-derives-requirements: unit: DocsCompiler derives a breaking stressor's requirements by querying origins (never a stored field), enforces one open session (E_SESSION), validates closed: stamps, and emits breaking_unanswered/pending_stressor/empty_session
candidates-carry-signal: unit: capture.mint mints a candidate only where the changed item's tokens overlap the ref's surface terms; no-signal pairs are suppressed not subtracted (counted, in --json, mintable via link add), and leftover reporting is unchanged
capture-at-the-join: e2e: the plan loop captures traceability at the task — spec_refs precede code, the wave-open item index pre-attributes changed symbols as candidates, confirm raises load-bearing ones to asserted, and only asserted links gate the next wave
coupling-is-measured: unit: Nkp computes K/P, regime, hotspots and corridors over the epistatic slice and Incidence joins pinned stressor affects with the invariant surface into the matrix and typed findings — both reading the compiled model only
dark-deltas-are-code: unit: one seam reads [audit] exclude from the manifest so capture, candidate search and the audit's delta scan share the built-in code boundary; verify and the fold ignore it — a link into an excluded file still verifies clean
deferral-is-explicit: unit: DocsCompiler derives the tri-state from satisfied-by + deferred — satisfied, deferred-with-reason, or open — rejects satisfied-and-deferred as E_DOC, and emits deferred_requirement (info) vs unsatisfied_requirement per state
docs-compile-with-the-model: unit: DocsCompiler validates every machine field against the live model and project-wide slugs — a renamed node a requirement names surfaces as E_MODEL_REF at its file, a slug collision as E_SLUG at both sites, on the next check
drift-graded-per-kind: unit: verify recomputes projections and grades each link Clean/Drifted/Moved/Missing against the watched hash — body for literal, interface for indirect — so reformatting drifts neither and evidence links never fail the gate
every-field-is-present: unit: DocsCompiler still schema-checks every doc — a missing, unknown, or misordered field, malformed frontmatter, or half-present satisfaction record stays E_DOC at the offending file:line (docs::schema_violations_are_e_doc).
every-verb-finds-its-project: e2e: every verb but init still resolves its project by --project else nearest archi.toml upward (neither = usage error), init takes its positional target, and each run compiles fresh through load_sources — no leftover artifact trusted.
exit-codes-are-the-contract: e2e: the three exits hold across every verb — 0 clean (findings advisory, benign no-ops succeed), 1 compile/schema/seal failure as file:line:col: CODE, 2 malformed usage; --help/--version answer on stdout exit 0 with no project.
findings-never-block: e2e: check still exits 0 on any clean compile whatever the findings (open reqs, unwired ports, decayed evidence advise, never fail) and non-zero only when a source fails to compile, a doc violates schema, or the archive fails its seal.
findings-read-the-matrix: unit: Incidence still emits its five typed, severity-tagged matrix findings, the declared-path walk splitting corroboration from contradiction within its --depth/--path-limit budget and auto-firing on the closing save.
gates-press-the-delta: e2e: the wave-close gate still demands asserted links only for spec_refs the delta presses (by capture's term test), closes unpressed deltas without links, and renders uncovered pressed refs as archi link add checklist suggestions.
git-speaks-from-its-own-root: e2e: every git read still resolves the repo's real top level and rebases output into the consulted member's frame before comparison, so a project below its git root audits/verifies correctly and out-of-frame paths drop with a note.
one-claim-one-file: unit: DocsCompiler still walks intent folders into requirement trees across all three scales (section/file/folder), deriving each parent from the path alone and opening a subrequirement on any non-reserved heading.
one-repo-stays-the-default: unit: a memberless project stays byte-identical — the member qualifier remains an optional field in every schema, resolves to home when absent, and this project's own journal and version archive replay unchanged under the new parsers.
one-verb-searches-everything: e2e: archi search <phrase> still returns one ranked list across every KB object (elements, intents, requirements, stressors, sessions) with --kind, --limit (10 default) and --json honored — search "fold" still surfaces the fold round.
one-verb-stands-a-project-up: e2e: archi init [<dir>] still scaffolds source + briefing then writes archi.toml last, a following archi build passes compiling zero statements, and exits stay 0 (incl. no-op re-run) / 1 refused write / 2 malformed.
origin-records-why-placement-records-whe: unit: DocsCompiler still parses the origin grammar and keeps the two axes orthogonal — positional kinds cross-checked against placement (E_PLACEMENT), slug kinds against existence (E_DOC_REF) (docs::placement_is_meaning).
plans-revalidate-on-every-verb: unit: Planner still re-reads and re-validates plan.json on every verb load — authored fields edited in place, lifecycle state moved only through verbs — so a hand edit is accepted whole or named, never trusted from the last write.
refs-carry-their-repo: e2e: a member//file#symbol ref still round-trips through link add, ls and the journal, the unqualified form keeps meaning home and folds identically to its home twin, and a pre-members journal replays every anchor home.
rounds-fold-deliberately: e2e: conflict markers under archi/stress/ still raise one E_SESSION naming the session and fold verb ahead of any parse error, and session fold merges two rounds keeping both charters under ## Folded while refusing folds across pins.
satisfaction-is-a-checked-claim: unit: DocsCompiler still resolves each satisfied-by path against the live compile — a renamed node breaks with E_MODEL_REF at the requirement's line, ancestor transitivity holds, a bullet-less record stays unverified_satisfaction.
satisfaction-names-the-interface: unit: satisfied-by [Engine.answer] resolves and validates against a model that declares the port; satisfied-by naming canonical edge text resolves to that edge; a port path that names no declared port is a located E_DOC, not a silent pass
scans-see-every-mapped-member: unit: Capture/Grader still walk every mapped member and key items by qualified path — an absent checkout is reported unreachable, never silently dropped, and a bare exclude applies in every member, a qualified one only in its own.
scenarios-close-the-plan: unit: Planner's advance verb still rides the scenario latch pair — plan next prints the block and latches scenarios_displayed, the next latches scenarios_closed to DONE, reset clears both, and an empty scenarios set skips the step.
slugs-are-the-reference-currency: unit: DocsCompiler still derives each primitive's slug from its H1 (kebab), flags E_SLUG when name and filename diverge, and de-duplicates project-wide across every kind — a collision reports both sites.
stress-pins-versions: unit: open-session affects still validate against the model Archive reconstructs for the session's pinned id, not the live tree — renaming an affected node keeps the check green until the pin moves, and closed sessions stay re-analyzable.
tasks-derive-never-retype: unit: plan task add still seeds spec_refs with the node plus its incoming edges and pulls requirements by recomputing the reverse lookup per read — matches carry matched_refs and a slot_id, never a stored copy of the spec.
the-matrix-joins-stress-to-structure: unit: Incidence still expands each affects entry against its session's pinned version and joins to the frame — terms the frame lost surface under scope.dropped with DROPPED_AFFECTS, and --session/--since/--exclude-pending scope as before.
the-timeline-reads-back: e2e: the version read verbs still answer from the archive without git — list/show/diff render sealed versions (diff live compares the working tree) and current is derived by on-demand hashing, so it cannot lie about a dirty tree.
unchanged-saves-close-rounds: e2e: archi version save on an unchanged model still exits 0 — an open session closes against the current id with its incidence report, a bare no-op writes nothing, and only real failures like two open sessions exit nonzero.
under-stressed-names-behavior: unit: the under_stressed emission still mutes zero columns inside the type_of closure of Data while the matrix, hotspots and coupling see every term — --all-terms restores them, and a Data-less preset filters nothing.
verifications-forgive-the-dash: unit: a Satisfy bullet written with an ASCII hyphen, an en-dash and an em-dash each count as one verification; a `test`/`type-level` line that misses the shape raises the located diagnostic naming `- test — …`; a `*` bullet or a mistyped tag stays ordinary prose
verifications-gate-the-start: unit: Planner's shared gate still blocks plan start until the plan is structurally clean and every matched requirement carries at least one verification keyed by its slug — plan verify runs the same validator on demand.
waves-close-on-captured-coverage: e2e: plan next still closes a wave in one motion — capture mints each closing task's delta into candidate links, then the structural and pressed-coverage gates fire on the fold; a blocked gate is reviewed and retried, never forced.

tasks.stack_details: links/mod.rs: the SpecRef parser gains a port-path arm beside the node-path and canonical-edge-text arms it already has, resolving through t1's Model::resolve_element so a port anchors a link exactly as an edge does. A link on a port grades, verifies and audits like any other — the projection is unchanged, only what can be named at the spec end widens. Inline unit tests for `link add` on a port path and its verify/audit round-trip.
